text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Steelers at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET for their home opener, the team faces a significant challenge with A.J. Brown's placement on injured reserve following a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1 that will sideline him for at least four games, forcing other receivers to step up in his absence as Mike Reiss examines the adjusted game plan heading into the contest. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the team's preparations in his Wednesday press conference, while off the field, Drake Maye continued to demonstrate his character by teaming with his wife Ann Michael to surprise over 50 teachers at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence with a generous back-to-school donation covering their Amazon classroom wish lists. Owner Robert Kraft also made headlines this week by explaining his decision to have Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming Gillette Stadium performances, citing the artist's "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
